notes.title: Kittengumi Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44229895/ba68edb55a1592223e1e87ea3d0158b2a880cf47.png

We've been listening to your feedback, and we went to work to improve Kittengumi: The Sakabato's Thief. And now you can enjoy this improvements in this latest patch. Some of these new additions are:

New backlog menu where you can re-read all the past dialogue.
New font size option in the option menu.
New entering to the scene animation for characters.
New option to mute the sound at the end of a sentence.
Further more, we've fixed small bugs, that you the community, have been reporting to us. Thank you very much for all your support, and stay tuned for future news!
